latHint: Think getting tough on crime - not a workshop grip.
pivHint: A CLAMP grips wood in the shop - but to CLAMP down on crime means to what down on it?
winText: Zero tolerance. CLAMP was the pivot - a wood grip to a CRACK down on crime.
lossText: CRACK - to act severely. CLAMP was the pivot: a wood CLAMP to a CLAMP down.
